description: The bar chart compares the performance of different models across several evaluation metrics, with the x-axis listing the models and the y-axis representing performance scores. The models compared are PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and a base model labeled "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)". For each model, three bars are shown: a dark blue bar representing "RedWhale (our)", a light blue bar representing "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and a light gray bar representing the "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" model. The performance scores are displayed above each bar. The chart shows that the "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" model consistently achieves a score of 1.00 across all metrics. The "RedWhale (our)" model generally performs better than the "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" model, with the exception of the "KoBEST-HS" metric where the "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" model has a slightly higher score (0.73 vs. 0.69). The "RedWhale (our)" model achieves scores of 0.42, 0.52, 0.71, 0.50, 0.69, and 0.57 for the respective metrics, while the "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" model achieves scores of 0.46, 0.56, 0.74, 0.54, 0.73, and 0.61. The "AVG" label at the end of the x-axis suggests that the scores are averaged across the metrics.
